blocks.text: Radio personality Martin Oliver Solis Dipasupil, popularly known as DJ Martin D, one of the longtime voices of 101.9 FM, has died at the age of 56. Yey Carteciano, a family member, announced Dipasupil’s death in a Facebook post on Sunday, Sept. 27, saying he passed away early this morning. “We are still trying to process this painful loss, but we want to extend our deepest gratitude to everyone who has reached out, offered prayers, and extended their sympathy. Your kindness means the world to us during this incredibly difficult time,” she wrote. Carteciano added that details of Dipasupil’s wake will […]...
